content.title: LFUS Q2 Deep Dive: Industrial and Data Center Momentum Fuel Guidance Upside
content.summary: Electronic component provider Littelfuse (NASDAQ:LFUS) reported Q2 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 9.8% year on year to $613.4 million. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($620 million at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 6.7% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.85 per share was 22.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
